summary_md: **splatsandworlds ([@splatworlds](https://x.com/splatworlds/status/2115112558017331266))** highlights the paper *State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels*: a **Stateful Harness** executes explicit rules and hidden state (e.g., whether a character has a key) before a frozen video world model renders the outcome, so identical frames and actions can settle into different, correct endings.

referenced_urls.title: State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels

relevance: A harness-around-a-generator pattern that gives video world models consistent hidden state.

media.description: 'Counterfactual twins' figure: two rollouts with identical first frame and action ('open the chest') but different hidden state (has_key false/true); a frozen video world model collapses both to the same ending, while the proposed stateful harness (semantic ledger, deterministic rules, editable clay model) settles them into different correct endings.
